_comment: Stuffy Doll, design step 4. Doll + four opponent Spirits = 5 creatures, so Blasphemous Act
({8}{R}, {1} less per creature on the battlefield, BOTH sides) costs {3}{R} off four lands. Its
13 to each creature is ONE event: the Spirits die, the INDESTRUCTIBLE Doll survives with 13
marked, and its reflection deals that much -- 13, not 1 (ruling) -- to the chosen player, the
opponent at 13. Without the Act the best is one ping a turn, so a T4 win needs the sweep.
